articles.title: Motilal Oswal initiates coverage on Astra Microwave, sees 24% upside. Here are 8 reasons why
articles.summary: Motilal Oswal initiated a 'Buy' rating for Astra Microwave Products Ltd (AMPL). AMPL is a vital Indian company, manufacturing high-frequency microwave and RF components critical for defence, space, and meteorological applications. This positive assessment underscores AMPL's significance in enhancing India's strategic technological independence and defence capabilities, playing a key role in national security.

articles.title: Taiwan says Chinese aircraft carrier sailed through Taiwan Strait
articles.summary: China's newest and most advanced aircraft carrier, the Fujian, recently completed its inaugural transit through the sensitive Taiwan Strait. This significant move, confirmed by Taiwan's defence ministry, underscores China's rapidly expanding naval capabilities and its growing assertiveness in a critical geopolitical region. For SSB aspirants, this highlights increasing military presence and potential flashpoints in international waters, demonstrating the importance of maritime power projection.
